name: Isabel Barrera
bio: Isabel co-founded Runway – the first control center for mobile app releases – after spending nearly a decade building iOS apps at companies like Rent the Runway, ClassPass, and Kickstarter. She’s passionate about mobile architecture, improving and innovating on team processes, and helping make developer’s lives easier with better tooling. Originally from Mexico, she spent most of her childhood in Canada and is currently living in Brooklyn, New York where you’ll find her in a perpetual search for the best slice of pizza.
